Rodríguez (Netcompany Ineos) starts from his hometown today: “I hadn’t asked for it, but it’s much appreciated. It’s always special to set off from where you were born, from where you’re from. So, anyway, let’s enjoy today, because it doesn’t happen every day. Yes, there’s always been a stage that passed nearby or went through the village; as a child who loved cycling, I always enjoyed going to watch the professionals, my idols. Nowadays, being part of this peloton is something very special, and even more so with the start here. I hope to get back to my best form, to perform well. And, above all, to enjoy this experience, to enjoy La Vuelta as much as I can.
